items.title: What Are Solar Satellite Interferences?
items.summary: TL;DR Sun outages occur when solar radiation overwhelms satellite signals passing directly in front of the sun, causing temporary broadcast disruptions. Fiber TV users experience outages because national networks broadcast content via satellite before distributing it across local fiber systems.
